$comment: The second set of foil printings, chosen rather than drawn: artwork foil for ten of the cutest cards, reverse foil for ten of the coolest, full-card foil for ten of the most underrated, and a detail mask for five cards with a detail worth shining. Every card here had no foil printing before. See SECOND_FOILS.md.

cards.name: Comet
cards.title: Bolt Sorter
cards.why: A kitten on the hangar floor, putting bolts in the right tin.

cards.name: Osh
cards.title: Sharpener's Boy
cards.why: Not yet allowed the wheel, and carrying the wheel anyway.

cards.name: Marmalade
cards.title: Dough Kneader
cards.why: Paws in the flour, with a smaller kitten asleep on the bench.

cards.name: Gabe
cards.title: Corner Show
cards.why: Forty puppets and a floor of kittens who know every one of them.

cards.name: Jessica
cards.title: Song and Game Leader
cards.why: The constellations as a round, with actions, in a ring of kits.

cards.name: Quill
cards.title: Orchard Hand
cards.why: Grown up under the rows, handing windfalls to smaller ones.

cards.name: Lindsay
cards.title: Herb Grower
cards.why: Two kittens up to their elbows in the herb bed.

cards.name: Rosabeth
cards.title: Garden Hand
cards.why: Singing at the far end of the beds, with the new hand alongside.

cards.name: Clover
cards.title: Plot Sharer
cards.why: A pot handed down to the smallest gardener on the strip.

cards.name: Cookie
cards.title: Biscuit Maker
cards.why: A squirrel, the last of the oven heat, and a biscuit held up to it.

cards.name: Brooke
cards.title: Balloonist
cards.why: Sunrise over the river from a basket, one paw on the brass burner.

cards.name: Morty
cards.title: Steam Engineer
cards.why: Copper, steam and a pressure gauge that has never yet been wrong.

cards.name: Yellow
cards.title: Freshest Thing in a Small Town
cards.why: Sunglasses indoors, a brass microphone, and the room already won.

cards.name: The Eclipse
cards.why: The whole borough out on the wall, looking up at a ring of fire.

cards.name: Willow
cards.title: Harbour Admiral
cards.why: The harbour’s whole coat, worn as though it weighed nothing.

cards.name: Biff
cards.title: Chief Constable
cards.why: Chain of office, lit street, and everybody’s name.

cards.name: Betty
cards.title: Firework Maker
cards.why: Ear defenders on, fuse in hand, rockets ranked along the bench.

cards.name: Tabitha
cards.title: Camerawoman
cards.why: Under the hood in the dark with the whole festival behind her.

cards.name: Moss
cards.title: Rocketwright
cards.why: A copper rocket on trestles, in a shop that mostly builds bridges.

cards.name: Patch
cards.title: Junkyard Diver
cards.why: On top of the scrap mountain, holding up the one good gear.

cards.name: Cassadee
cards.title: The Only One at the Back
cards.why: Books it, sweeps it, sets the chairs, and puts them away at midnight.

cards.name: Abigail
cards.title: The Standing Slot
cards.why: Never the thing the room remembers, and on her feet after a full shift.

cards.name: Fred
cards.title: Backstage Crew (Nobody Asked)
cards.why: Never told the name of the show, and still has not asked.

cards.name: Winter
cards.title: Turned-Down Applicant
cards.why: Two courteous letters, no seat, and everything he read for the second one.

cards.name: Oatmeal
cards.title: Sunday Table
cards.why: Nine at the table since he was eleven, and never once thanked for it.

cards.name: Ned
cards.title: The Ward Roll
cards.why: Every roll and return, filed and correct, because nearly correct is not.

cards.name: Kevin
cards.title: Counter Hand
cards.why: Job nine of eleven, the one nobody counts, worth two of anybody at it.

cards.name: Hibiscus
cards.title: The Sorting Bench
cards.why: The handover at five, and a round that takes seven hours on purpose.

cards.name: Sota
cards.title: The Same Bench
cards.why: Grinds the glass all night and will not look through it.

cards.name: Peter
cards.title: Washing Up
cards.why: At the sink from November, back on the hedge in March, said nothing about either.

cards.name: Sage
cards.title: Astronomer
cards.why: The brass telescope barrel and the pillars of its stand.

cards.name: Bean
cards.title: Espresso Puller
cards.why: The copper and brass of the espresso machine.

cards.name: Liz
cards.title: Weighbridge Keeper
cards.why: The weighing dial and the pillars it stands on.

cards.name: Copper
cards.title: Scale Polisher
cards.why: The pan polished to a mirror, its stand and the chain above it.

cards.name: Mandee
cards.title: Weather Watcher
cards.why: The barometer she reads and the weathervane above it.
